description: Source terms of the game's own English text with what they mean and where they occur (docs/modding/translation-handbook.md). Terms only: the text of the game is not kept in the repository. A language's glossary_<lang>.json gives its form of every term; translate the term the same way in every file.

terms.Silent Hill: The resort town of the story. A proper name; not translated.
terms.Harry Mason: The player character, a writer, 32, widower. Looks for his adopted daughter. Male speaker.
terms.Cheryl: Harry's daughter, 7, short black hair. Calls him Daddy.
terms.Cybil Bennett: Police officer from the next town, Brahms. Female speaker, brisk and practical.
terms.Dahlia Gillespie: Old woman, head of the town's cult, Alessa's mother. Female speaker; prophetic, archaic, never plain.
terms.Alessa Gillespie: Dahlia's daughter, burned seven years ago, kept alive in the hospital. Calls Dahlia Mommy/Mama.
terms.Michael Kaufmann: Director of Alchemilla Hospital, involved in the drug trade. Male speaker; curt, irritable.
terms.Lisa Garland: Young nurse of Alchemilla Hospital. Female speaker; informal, frightened.
terms.K. Gordon: A teacher of the school; the name on a house, a key tag and the list of teachers. Must be identical in all three.
terms.Moore, Ranaldo, Gordon: Names on the list of teachers.
terms.Leonard Rhine: Author's name on a book cover in the school.
terms.The Monster Lurks: Title of that book; also quoted by Harry.
terms.Norman Young: Owner of the motel; signs the delivery memo.
terms.Officer Gucci: Narcotics officer who died of a heart failure (police memo).
terms.Alchemilla Hospital: The hospital; a sign, repeated in three maps.
terms.Balkan Church: The church where Dahlia is met; a sign.
terms.the other church: Dahlia's words for the hidden altar behind the antique shop; Harry quotes them later. Keep the same wording.
terms.Orridge Bridge Control Room: A sign on the drawbridge control room.
Street of the doghouse; written by Cheryl, repeated in the item description.
terms.Lake Side Amusement Park: A sign, upper case in the source.
terms.water works: Abandoned water works with a tunnel to the lake; Lisa mentions it, Harry repeats it.
terms.resort area: District of the town; in map names.
terms.residential area: District of the town; in a map name.
terms.shopping district: District of the town; in a map name.
terms.sewer: Two sewer maps and two keys.
terms.antique shop: The shop Dahlia's key opens; its sign is 'green lion'.
terms.green lion: The shop's sign, lower case; an alchemical symbol.
terms.basement storeroom: Room of the hospital basement; a key and Lisa's line about strict orders.
terms.library reserve: The school library's reserve room; a key.
terms.boiler room: School boiler room; the 5:00 clue points to it.
terms.clock tower: School clock tower; pictured on both medallions.
terms.drawbridge: The bridge to the other part of the town; a key.
terms.Otherworld: Harry's word for the nightmare version of the town.
terms.darkness: Dahlia's 'the town is being devoured by darkness'; quoted back by Harry, Cybil and Lisa. One word everywhere.
terms.Flauros: Pyramid-shaped object Dahlia gives Harry; a demon's name. In brackets as an item name.
terms.Aglaophotis: Red liquid that expels demons; Kaufmann's vial. An occult plant name.
terms.talisman of Metraton: Sic in the source (Metatron). The seal Alessa was drawing over the town.
terms.mark of Samael: What Dahlia calls that same seal. Samael is a demon/angel name.
terms.Gyromancy: A kind of divination; Dahlia's first line.
terms.God: The cult's deity; 'He' in Dahlia's last speech refers to it.
terms.mother of God: Dahlia's last line before the birth.
terms.White Claudia: Plant the drug is made of; police memo and the botanical book.
terms.PTV: Name of the drug in the newspaper; left in Latin letters.
terms.lithograph / slate: The stone slab with the riddle in the hospital of Nowhere; both words name the same object.
terms.A Golden Sun: Inscription at the medallion slot of the clock tower.
terms.A Silver Moon: Inscription at the medallion slot of the clock tower.
terms.Lion / Woodman / Scarecrow: Three keys named after The Wizard of Oz; use the names of the language's own edition of the book.
terms.Mock Turtle: Plate; Alice in Wonderland character; use the language's established name.
terms.Ophiel / Hagith / Phaleg / Bethor / Arat: Olympian spirits; names on five keys and five doors. Key name, door inscription and item description must match.
terms.Amulet of Solomon: One of the five ritual items.
terms.Crest of Mercury: One of the five ritual items.
terms.Ankh: One of the five ritual items.
terms.Dagger of Melchior: One of the five ritual items; Melchior is one of the Magi.
terms.Disk of Ouroboros: One of the five ritual items.
terms.Channeling stone: Item of the UFO ending; channeling as contact with spirits or aliens.
terms.Chemical: Bottle of hydrochloric acid; the 'sage's water' of the 10:00 clue.
terms.Plate of [..]: Four coloured plates of the hospital door.
terms.Rock drill: Pneumatic drill of road works; a weapon.
terms.Pocket radio: Emits static when monsters are near.
terms.Handgun / Hunting rifle / Shotgun: Firearms; the ammunition names and the pickup messages repeat them.
terms.monster: Harry's and Kaufmann's word for the creatures.
terms.There is a X. Take it?: Pickup prompt, about 120 strings; one pattern.
Use message, about 40 strings; one pattern.
